verdict.rationale: Cerebras is API-first: the console/playground is mainly a convenience wrapper (chat trial, key management, dashboard) over the same inference API that supports streaming, tool use, structured outputs, batch, vision, dedicated endpoints, and fine-tuned model deployment, so most UI-visible functionality is API-accessible. However, some console-only administrative functions (team/access management, billing dashboards) aren't clearly exposed as API endpoints, and no OpenAPI spec was found to confirm full parity. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/API reference confirming 1:1 parity with console features, API endpoints for team/billing/access management shown only in the console, and independent confirmation that all console actions have API equivalents.
